candidate: C1: QQQ hourly dip-buy + VIX/VIX3M gate + F3_EVENT, hold 35 bars (v4 definition, unchanged)
status: EXPLORATORY and marginal. Designed after the final window had been seen (second-use window). Pre-registered v4 label: SUPPORTED (Sharpe 0.514 on 2020-01-03..2026-11-12; final-window block weak). The forward shadow log is its only independent evidence.

rule.gate: VIX/VIX3M close of the previous session < 1.0 (missing or stale gate data = no entry, same as the backtest engine)
rule.entry: open of the bar after the signal bar
rule.exit: after H bars (open of next bar) or when a bar closes <= entry*(1-3%)
rule.F3_EVENT: skip entries whose ENTRY DAY (ET) has an event in the list below

hand_added_event_days_et.event: Non Farm Payrolls (Oct) = BLS Employment Situation, 8:30 ET
Inflation Rate MoM (Oct) = BLS Consumer Price Index, 8:30 ET

shadow.mode: read-only signal log. This software places NO orders and uses a read-only API connection.
shadow.data_feed: IBKR TWS/Gateway read-only, port 4003, clientId 9201; VIX/VIX3M from IBKR index bars, else the R2 snapshot, else 50_paper/vix_manual.csv
shadow.hypothetical_fill: open of the bar after the signal bar, 0.10% per side, USD 100,000 unit
shadow.events_beyond_verified_date: entries are logged with event_status UNVERIFIED until the official Fed/BLS calendars have been checked for that date (50_paper/events_verified_through.txt and events_manual.csv)
shadow.every_dip_is_logged: including dips that were not traded, with the reason (gate closed, blocked by F3, already in position, data missing)

reporting_rule: Every logged row is reported as it comes out, including losing trades, unverified-calendar rows and dips that were not traded. No parameter, filter or date list changes after this file is hashed; the log is append-only.
paper_orders: None. Real paper orders on the new paper account (port 4004) would be a separate step that needs kt's explicit approval and its own written order policy.
